description: Ministry of Water Supply - Access road of Dippitiya Service Reservoir of Kandy North, Pathadumbare Integrated Water Supply Scheme of Kandy North
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for public infrastructure projects (water supply projects). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, including lot numbers, land names, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. The order is made under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, but the core content focuses on the acquisition of immobile properties (land) rather than legal/regulatory changes or government personnel matters.
